messages:
anya: Quick check ahead of MVP freeze: infra found an OOM regression on embeddings; legal wants more on multi-tenant SSO. Strawman cutlist: MUST: core API, single-tenant SSO, telemetry; SHOULD: embeddings cache behind flag; CUT: tenant routing and advanced admin. Thoughts?

rio: I agree with cutting tenant routing. Emb cache behind flag only if infra can certify no OOM in 48h soak.

sam: UX: cutting tenant routing breaks the onboarding demo. I can ship a 2-screen demo shim to fake tenants in ~3d.

maria: Data: without cache we see ~20% latency increase on recommend queries. If deferred, create a baseline run so we can measure impact later.

lina: Infra note: regression likely from KV eviction + a quant change. Hotfix estimate ~5d dev + 2d validation. Calendar impact = ~8 business days to internal readiness.

anya: Decision rule: if infra confirms a safe hotfix and 48h soak by Thu EOD -> include cache behind flag with strict canary and rollback. Otherwise -> cut cache to v1 and ship demo shim. SLA for canary: p95 < 300ms and cost delta < 1.5x, else rollback.

deploy-bot: milestone:Q2-MVP readiness updated by anya status: "cutlist-awaiting-infra"

anya: Action items: rio confirm infra ETA, sam scope demo shim, maria run baseline perf, lina post ETA. Reconvene Fri 9:30.
